metadata.title: High-velocity runaway stars from three-body encounters

notes: No eligible stars. The paper reports population simulations of unnamed 8 M⊙ and 4 M⊙ escapers from generic binaries (T:p2-b4, T:p3-b4, T:p4-b1; I:p3-b0, I:p3-b1, I:p3-b2, I:p3-b3), not identifiable individual stars. HE 0437−5439 and HD 271791 are cited only as prior-literature HVS examples (T:p1-b11) and are not selected, analyzed, or followed up in this paper; their proposed origins do not establish present-day Galactic-unbound candidacy.
